brand.name: Airhost
brand.tone: Friendly but efficient - guests are usually mid-trip and want a straight answer.

shared_notes: Airhost manages the property; guests book through the platform. The guest line is answered at any hour. Never share the owner's personal contact details.

properties.name: Example Apartment, Manchester
properties.check_in: From 3pm, self check-in via the key safe by the front door
properties.key_safe_code: Sent automatically the morning of arrival - never quote it before then
properties.wifi: Network 'Example-5G', password in the welcome book on the kitchen counter
properties.parking: No on-site parking. Nearest car park is Example NCP, 4 minutes walk
properties.smoking: Not allowed anywhere on the property, including the balcony
properties.extra_guests: Maximum 4, no exceptions - the fire certificate covers 4
local_tips: Good coffee at the place on the corner
escalate_if: Anything about damage or a broken appliance
